notes.title: [Official Announcement] DLC included
notes.notes:
Dear Fans

We would like to inform you that 7 unique wallpapers will be automatically downloaded to your computer until the 13th April as a special promotion of our release. If you check your steam folder, you should be able to find the Wallpapers automatically downloaded from steam.

Simply go to 
My computer->C: (or wherever your steam applications are downloaded) -> Program files -> Steam -> Steamapps -> Common -> 7 scarlet

All beta testers and players who purchased the 7'scarlet shall receive this wallpaper automatically.

Thank you for your support as always!
-Intragames Team-
